instruction: Create a LAMP stack with Docker Compose
output: echo 'services: web: image: nginx:latest ports: - 8080:80 volumes: - ./html:/usr/share/nginx/html app: image: php:8-fpm volumes: - ./html:/var/www/html db: image: mariadb environment: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: rootpass' > docker-compose.yml

instruction: Create a MEAN stack with Docker Compose
output: echo 'services: angular: image: nginx ports: - 80:80 api: image: node:20 command: node server.js mongo: image: mongo volumes: - mongo_data:/data/db volumes: mongo_data:' > docker-compose.yml

instruction: Create a WordPress site with compose
output: echo 'services: wordpress: image: wordpress ports: - 8080:80 environment: WORDPRESS_DB_HOST: db WORDPRESS_DB_USER: wpuser WORDPRESS_DB_PASSWORD: secret db: image: mysql:8 environment: MYSQL_DATABASE: wordpress MYSQL_USER: wpuser MYSQL_PASSWORD: secret MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: rootpass' > docker-compose.yml

instruction: Create a reverse proxy with Nginx and Let's Encrypt
output: echo 'services: nginx: image: nginx:alpine volumes: - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf - ./letsencrypt:/etc/letsencrypt ports: - 443:443 certbot: image: certbot/certbot volumes: - ./letsencrypt:/etc/letsencrypt entrypoint: certbot renew' > docker-compose.yml

instruction: Create a Redis cache with compose
output: echo 'services: redis: image: redis:alpine command: redis-server --appendonly yes volumes: - redis_data:/data volumes: redis_data:' > docker-compose.yml

instruction: Create a RabbitMQ cluster with compose
output: echo 'services: rabbit1: image: rabbitmq:3-management environment: RABBITMQ_ERLANG_COOKIE: secretcookie rabbit2: image: rabbitmq:3-management environment: RABBITMQ_ERLANG_COOKIE: secretcookie depends_on: - rabbit1' > docker-compose.yml

instruction: Create an ELK stack with compose
output: echo 'services: elasticsearch: image: elasticsearch:8 environment: discovery.type: single-node kibana: image: kibana:8 ports: - 5601:5601 depends_on: - elasticsearch logstash: image: logstash:8 volumes: - ./logstash.conf:/usr/share/logstash/pipeline/logstash.conf depends_on: - elasticsearch' > docker-compose.yml

instruction: Create a Prometheus and Grafana stack
output: echo 'services: prometheus: image: prom/prometheus volumes: - ./prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml grafana: image: grafana/grafana ports: - 3000:3000 depends_on: - prometheus' > docker-compose.yml

instruction: Create a MinIO object storage with compose
output: echo 'services: minio: image: minio/minio command: server /data --console-address :9001 environment: MINIO_ROOT_USER: admin MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: password ports: - 9000:9000 - 9001:9001 volumes: - minio_data:/data volumes: minio_data:' > docker-compose.yml

instruction: Create a Jenkins CI service with compose
output: echo 'services: jenkins: image: jenkins/jenkins:lts ports: - 8080:8080 - 50000:50000 volumes: - jenkins_home:/var/jenkins_home - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock volumes: jenkins_home:' > docker-compose.yml

instruction: Run a Jupyter notebook with compose
output: echo 'services: jupyter: image: jupyter/datascience-notebook ports: - 8888:8888 volumes: - ./notebooks:/home/jovyan/work' > docker-compose.yml

instruction: Create a Traefik reverse proxy with compose
output: echo 'services: traefik: image: traefik:v3.0 command: --api.dashboard=true --providers.docker ports: - 80:80 - 8080:8080 volumes: - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock' > docker-compose.yml

instruction: Create a Selenium grid with compose
output: echo 'services: hub: image: selenium/hub ports: - 4442:4442 - 4443:4443 - 4444:4444 chrome: image: selenium/node-chrome shm_size: 2gb depends_on: - hub environment: SE_EVENT_BUS_HOST: hub' > docker-compose.yml

instruction: Create a Kafka cluster with compose
output: echo 'services: zookeeper: image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper environment: ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181 kafka: image: confluentinc/cp-kafka depends_on: - zookeeper environment: KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1 KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181 KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://localhost:9092 ports: - 9092:9092' > docker-compose.yml
